data.name: Ayah
data.gender_notes: Ayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, Ayah refers to a verse or a sign. It is a term used to describe a passage of the Quran that conveys a message or a warning. Ayah is also used to describe a sign or a miracle. The name Ayah carries the meaning “Sign/Verse from Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayah usually hope their child will grow to embody sign/verse from quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign or a verse from Allah in the Quran.
data.etymology: Ayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sign/Verse from Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: آية
in_arabic.meaning: علامت، نشان، وحی، قرآن کی سورت کا ایک حصہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: آية کا مطلب ہے علامت یا نشان جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت و حکمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن مجید میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، جہاں یہ اللہ کی وحی اور معجزات کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔ آية کا استعمال اسلامی تقویم میں بھی ہوتا ہے، جہاں یہ مخصوص تاریخوں اور واقعات کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال کی جاتی ہے۔

in_urdu.name: آیت
in_urdu.meaning: علامت، نشان، وحی، قرآن کی سورت کا ایک حصہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: آیت نام کا مطلب ہے علامت یا نشان جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت و حکمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن مجید میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، جہاں یہ اللہ کی وحی اور معجزات کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔ آیت نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں یہ نام لڑکیوں کو دیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आयत
in_hindi.meaning: चिह्न, निशान, वही, कुरआन का एक हिस्सा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयत नाम का अर्थ है चिह्न या निशान जो अल्लाह की शक्ति और बुद्धि को प्रकट करता है। यह शब्द कुरआन में भी प्रयोग हुआ है, जहां यह अल्लाह की वही और चमत्कारों को व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयोग किया गया है। आयत नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, जहां यह नाम लड़कियों को दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: آیه
in_pashto.meaning: نښه، علامت، وحی، قرانکى سورت يوه برخه
in_pashto.long_meaning: آیه نوم معنی دے نښه یا علامت چه الله تعالی قدرت و حکمت ښیي. دا کلمه په قران کریم کې هم استعمال شوې ده، چیرته چې دا د الله وحی او معجزاتو دبیانولو لپاره استعمال شوې ده. آیه نوم په افغان او پښتون دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري، په ځانګړي ډول دا نوم نجونو ته ورکول کیږي.

in_english.name: Ayah
in_english.meaning: Sign, indication, revelation, verse of the Quran
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ayah is derived from the Arabic root 'A-Y-W' which means 'to signify' or 'to indicate'. In Islamic context, Ayah refers to a sign or indication of God's power and wisdom. The term is also used in the Quran to describe revelations and verses. Ayah is a significant name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing spiritual guidance and enlightenment. The name is commonly used across Muslim cultures, particularly for girls.

data.cultural_impact: The word Ayah is not just limited to the religious context; it is also used in common Arabic language to mean a sign, a wonder, or a symbol. Ayah holds significant cultural importance in Islam as it is mentioned frequently in the Quran and Hadiths. It is a reminder of the divine power of Allah and the purpose of revelation.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, Ayah holds a deep significance for Muslims as it represents the messages sent by Allah to guide and warn humanity. Ayah is a reminder of the divine wisdom and purpose of life. By reflecting on the Ayahs of the Quran, Muslims seek to gain a better understanding of themselves, their purpose in life, and their relationship with Allah. Ayah also serves as a source of comfort and guidance during difficult times. The belief that every moment in life is a sign from Allah, known as Ayah al-Khabar, further emphasizes the importance of mindfulness and gratitude. Ultimately, the term Ayah underscores the fundamental tenet of Islam: the belief in the oneness of Allah and the belief that everything in the universe is a manifestation of His will and power.
